description: Latest USDA WASDE supply/demand projections for one commodity — beginning stocks, production, imports, exports, domestic consumption, and ending stocks — from the FAS PSD database behind the monthly WASDE report. Use for the current balance-sheet outlook; use get_wasde_history instead to see how a single figure has been revised across reports. Read-only lookup of stored projections; no API key. Returns the newest stored report's values for the requested marketing year (default: the current marketing year, where e.g. 2026 means the 2025/26 season) and country (default WORLD aggregate; US, BR, and AR are also tracked).

commodity.description: Commodity slug (e.g. corn, wheat, soybeans, rice, cotton)

country.description: Country code (WORLD, US, BR, AR). Default: WORLD aggregate

market_year.description: Marketing year (e.g. 2026 = 2025/26 season). Default: current marketing year

name: get_wasde_projection
